title: Candace Carter reads from “Sequenda”
description: In the first book of Candace Carter’s utopian trilogy “New News from the West”, the main character Pascal and his friends, guided by the principles of non-violence, friendship and music, brought dualism to an end and ushered humanity into the Age of the Parousia. But what if there were other worlds – or, more precisely, other dimensions? In “Sequenda” Pascal follows his dog Timi2 through a mysterious curtain and finds himself in a universe where the boundaries of the real dissolve into the imagined, and every encounter is a mirror of the infinite… Candace Carter, born in the Midwestern United States, studied at the Hochschule für Bildende Künste Hamburg. She works across multiple disciplines as a painter, performance artist, author, YouTuber, and podcaster. Admission free, donations to the Friends of the American Library e.V. cheerfully accepted.
